title: VP Supply Chain and Operations
text:
Vice President of Global Supply Chain and Operations

**Location:** Greater Phoenix, Arizona (On-site)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**Base Salary:** $180,000–$220,000

**Additional Compensation:** 30% annual bonus and equity opportunity

**Travel:** Approximately 30–40%, including international travel

**Relocation Assistance Available**

Position Overview

Seeking an accomplished supply chain and operations executive to lead an expanding domestic and international manufacturing and distribution operation.

This individual will be responsible for developing a scalable, efficient and commercially successful supply chain that supports significant business growth while maintaining exceptional product quality, customer satisfaction and profitability.

The ideal candidate combines executive leadership capabilities with an engineering foundation, extensive outsourced manufacturing experience, strong financial and commercial acumen, and a willingness to remain actively involved in operational execution.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment and enjoys building teams, improving processes, solving complex manufacturing challenges and establishing the operational infrastructure necessary to support rapid expansion.

Experience within packaging, foodservice products, consumer goods or other regulated manufacturing environments is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

**Manufacturing and Supplier Management**

* Direct a geographically distributed network of third-party manufacturing and production partners.
* Evaluate, qualify and develop suppliers based on manufacturing capabilities, quality, capacity, financial performance and service levels.
* Oversee supplier agreements, commercial relationships, pricing negotiations and performance improvement initiatives.
* Incorporate additional manufacturing facilities and production partners into the existing supply chain.
* Establish consistent supplier performance standards, accountability measures and operating procedures.

**Financial Performance and Cost Optimization**

* Develop strategies to improve gross margins, reduce manufacturing expenses and maximize operational efficiency.
* Create detailed manufacturing cost models and should-cost analyses to support supplier negotiations, commercial decisions and customer pricing.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through sourcing strategies, production efficiencies, transportation optimization and inventory management.
* Partner with commercial and financial leadership to align operational decisions with business objectives.
* Improve working capital utilization while maintaining appropriate service levels.

**Supply Chain Planning and Customer Fulfillment**

* Oversee the complete fulfillment process, from demand forecasting and production scheduling through final customer delivery.
* Establish and manage an effective Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) program.
* Ensure customer delivery commitments, product specifications and quality expectations are consistently achieved.
* Coordinate manufacturing capacity, inventory availability and production requirements with internal and external stakeholders.
* Develop strategies to minimize supply disruptions and improve supply chain reliability.
* Manage inventory performance, distribution operations and third-party logistics providers.

**Engineering, Product Launches and Manufacturing Readiness**

* Collaborate with engineering, product development and manufacturing teams to successfully transition new products into commercial production.
* Provide oversight of manufacturing feasibility, tooling development, production validation and supplier readiness.
* Ensure technical documentation, engineering specifications, drawings and bills of materials are properly maintained.
* Establish consistent product qualification and production approval procedures across manufacturing partners.
* Lead suppliers through technical, regulatory and customer approval requirements.

**Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance**

* Establish and maintain effective supplier quality management programs.
* Oversee manufacturing partner assessments, process audits, corrective actions and continuous improvement efforts.
* Ensure products satisfy applicable food-contact regulations, customer requirements and industry standards.
* Coordinate product testing, qualification and independent certification activities.
* Drive systematic resolution of manufacturing defects, customer complaints and recurring quality issues.

**Transportation and International Logistics**

* Manage domestic and international transportation, freight providers and distribution relationships.
* Optimize transportation costs, delivery performance and logistics processes.
* Oversee cross-border shipments, customs documentation and import/export compliance.
* Ensure effective coordination between manufacturing partners, warehouse operations and transportation providers.

**Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Analytics**

* Advance the organization's use of ERP systems, supply chain planning applications and operational reporting.
* Leverage artificial intelligence, intelligent agents and workflow automation to improve productivity and operational decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities involving supplier communications, purchasing, order visibility, quality documentation and performance reporting.
* Apply predictive analytics and data-driven methodologies to demand forecasting, manufacturing cost analysis and supplier evaluation.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure data integrity, information security and human oversight of AI-enabled processes.
* Promote adoption of emerging technologies throughout the operations organization.

**Executive Leadership and Organizational Development**

* Lead, mentor and expand a multidisciplinary supply chain and operations team.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operational metrics and individual accountability.
* Build processes and organizational capabilities that can support substantial business growth.
* Develop strong working relationships across sales, finance, engineering, product development and executive leadership.
* Serve as a trusted operational leader for strategic customers and manufacturing partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, manufacturing or operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated leadership of a substantial, multi-location outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing or co-manufacturing operation.
* Proven ability to negotiate complex manufacturing agreements, supplier pricing and measurable cost improvements.
* Experience developing manufacturing cost structures, should-cost models and product profitability analyses.
* Demonstrated success improving gross margins, operational efficiency and working capital performance.
* Experience supporting major customers within quick-service restaurants (QSR), large retail organizations or consumer packaged goods (CPG).
* Direct experience managing manufacturing partners or suppliers located in Mexico.
* Strong knowledge of demand planning, production planning, S&OP, inventory management, warehousing and third-party logistics.
* Experience managing international freight, customs requirements and cross-border supply chain operations.
* Understanding of quality management and regulatory requirements associated with food packaging or food manufacturing.
* Experience with applicable FDA requirements, SQF, BRCGS or comparable quality and food safety standards.
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline. Packaging engineering is preferred; mechanical, industrial, chemical, paper science or related engineering disciplines will be considered.
* Strong technical understanding of the product development and manufacturing lifecycle, including engineering specifications, tooling, production processes and product qualification.
* Experience with supplier qualification, First Article Inspection (FAI), manufacturing process validation, control plans and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) or equivalent methodologies.
* Familiarity with quality engineering methodologies, including PFMEA, SPC, structured root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA).
* Experience coordinating customer product approvals, regulatory testing and third-party product certifications.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop and lead high-performing teams.
* Practical experience applying AI-powered tools, intelligent agents or automated workflows to business operations.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or redesigning an operational workflow using AI or automation.
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience using operational data to guide business decisions.
* Experience with NetSuite ERP.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within fiber-based packaging, paper products, sustainable packaging, foodservice packaging or disposable consumer products.
* Experience overseeing outsourced manufacturing operations with annual spend or revenue approaching or exceeding $100 million.
* Professional proficiency in Spanish.
* Certified Packaging Professional (CPP) or a related technical credential.
* Familiarity with packaging conversion, fiber-forming technologies, surface treatments or similar manufacturing processes.
* Experience within a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial, venture-backed or private equity-backed organization.
* Previous involvement in launching manufacturing facilities or integrating new production partners.
* APICS/ASCM certifications, including CPIM or CSCP.
* Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma training or certification.

Ideal Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

* A hands-on executive who takes personal accountability for operational and customer outcomes.
* An entrepreneurial leader who is comfortable operating in a rapidly evolving business environment.
* A commercially oriented decision-maker who understands the relationship between manufacturing costs, revenue, profitability and cash flow.
* A strong negotiator capable of developing productive, long-term supplier relationships.
* A technically credible leader who can engage directly with engineers, manufacturing personnel and quality professionals.
* A resourceful problem-solver who remains composed when faced with competing priorities or demanding customer expectations.
* An organizational builder who introduces structure and discipline without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* A technology-forward executive who recognizes the practical value of AI, automation and advanced analytics.
* An effective communicator capable of influencing stakeholders across different functions, organizations and cultures.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual base salary of $180,000–$220,000, depending on qualifications and experience.
* Annual performance bonus opportunity of 30%.
* Equity or long-term incentive participation.
* Company-paid health and life insurance benefits.
* Relocation assistance for qualified candidates.
* Opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing organization.

This position requires regular on-site attendance in the Greater Phoenix area and approximately 30–40% domestic and international travel.

Pay: $180,000.00 - $220,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance

Application Question(s):

* Have you directly managed a multi-site contract manufacturing network?
* Do you have experience in food-contact packaging or food manufacturing?
* Have you implemented an AI-enabled or automated operational workflow?
* How many years of supply chain or manufacturing operations experience do you have?
* Have you developed should-cost models and negotiated manufacturing costs?

Ability to Relocate:

* Phoenix, AZ 85018: Relocate with an employer provided relocation package (Required)

Work Location: In person
